prompt:
主題：
冷蔵庫灯の白い夜

主体：
画面中央、開いた冷蔵庫へ背中を向ける若い女性。白い短丈トップ、灰色のルームショーツ、左手の白いボトル、長い髪と冷蔵庫灯が主役。

人物・表情：
小さな卵形の横顔、濃茶の瞳、細い眉、整った鼻、淡桃色の閉じた唇。顔と視線を冷蔵庫内へ向けた静かな表情。濃茶の非常に長いウェーブ髪は金具でハーフアップ、薄い前髪と後れ毛。

服装・ポーズ：
白い細リブの短い半袖トップは袖と裾にフリル。灰色の柔らかなショートパンツは縁フリルと背面の桃色リボン。冷蔵庫前に立ち、左手で青蓋の白いボトルを持ち、右手を棚へ伸ばす。

背景・光：
画面中央から右に開いた白い冷蔵庫と飲料、瓶、野菜、画面左に写真とメモ、前景左に台と緑。冷蔵庫内の白い光源が背中と手を柔らかく照らし、右外から暖色光が髪を縁取る。

構図・カメラ：
3:4の縦構図、腰と同じ高さの背後カメラで頭頂から腿中央までを収める三分身ポートレート。人物を中央へ大きく、冷蔵庫を右半分へ配置。腿は下端で裁切し、髪とボトルにピント、棚奥は軽くぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな実写写真。自然な肌、長い髪、リブ布、冷蔵庫の樹脂とガラス、食材を高精細にし、冷白光と暖色光を対比。

ネガティブ：
背面姿勢と長髪変更；白トップやボトル省略

promptTranslations.en:
Theme:
White night illuminated by the refrigerator light

Subject:
In the center of the frame, a young woman with her back to the open refrigerator. A white cropped top, gray loungewear shorts, a white bottle in her left hand, long hair, and the refrigerator light are the main focus.

Person and Expression:
A small, oval-shaped profile, dark brown eyes, thin eyebrows, a well-formed nose, and closed pale-pink lips. A quiet expression with her face and gaze directed toward the inside of the refrigerator. Dark brown, extremely long wavy hair styled in a half-updo with a metal clip, with wispy bangs and loose strands around the face.

Attire and Pose:
A white, fine-ribbed short-sleeved cropped top with ruffles on the sleeves and hem. Soft gray shorts with ruffled edges and a pink ribbon on the back. Standing in front of the refrigerator, holding a white bottle with a blue cap in her left hand, and reaching her right hand toward the shelf.

Background and Lighting:
An open white refrigerator with beverages, bottles, and vegetables spanning from the center to the right of the frame, photos and notes on the left side, and a counter with greenery in the left foreground. The white light source inside the refrigerator softly illuminates her back and hands, while warm light from the outside right rim-lights her hair.

Composition and Camera:
A 3:4 vertical composition, with the camera positioned behind at waist level, capturing a three-quarter portrait from the crown of the head to mid-thigh. The figure is prominently placed in the center, and the refrigerator occupies the right half. The thighs are cropped at the bottom edge, with focus on the hair and the bottle, while the deeper shelves are softly blurred.

Texture and Style:
A photorealistic live-action photograph. Natural skin, long hair, ribbed fabric, plastic and glass of the refrigerator, and food items rendered in high definition, contrasting cool white light with warm light.

Negative:
Change back posture and long hair; omit white top and bottle

summaryTranslations.en: Realistic AI photo prompt depicting the back view of a young woman holding a bottle in front of a refrigerator at midnight.

translations.zh: 主题：冰箱灯光的白夜。主体：画面中央背对镜头面朝打开冰箱的年轻女子，穿白色短上衣和灰色短裤，手持白瓶。人物/表情：侧脸，宁静神情，深棕色长卷发半扎发。服装/姿势：带花边短上衣与短裤，左手持瓶右手伸向隔板。背景/光线：打开的冰箱及食材，冷白光与侧暖光对比。构图/镜头：3:4竖画幅，腰部高度后视三分身人像。质感/风格：写实摄影。负面提示：改变背姿长发；省略白上衣或瓶子。
translations.en: Theme: White night under the refrigerator light. Subject: A young woman facing an open refrigerator from behind, wearing a cropped white top and grey shorts, holding a white bottle. Details: Soft profile expression, long wavy dark brown hair in a half-up clip. Clothing & Pose: Ruffled cropped top and shorts with a pink bow, holding a bottle with a blue cap. Lighting & Background: Open fridge with drinks, soft cold white illumination paired with warm rim light. Camera: 3:4 three-quarter rear portrait. Style: Photorealistic.
